name: DataAnalysisWorkflowV2
definition: {"Comment": "Data Analysis V2 Workflow - ERD and Data Lineage Generation", "StartAt": "CaptureStartTime", "States": {"CaptureStartTime": {"Type": "Pass", "Comment": "Capture workflow start time", "Parameters": {"started_at.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime"}, "ResultPath": "$.workflow_metadata", "Next": "UpdateStatusRunning"}, "UpdateStatusRunning": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Update job status to running", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putObject", "Parameters": {"Bucket": "code-transformation-v2", "Key.$": "States.Format('{}/{}/data_analysis_v2/jobs/{}/status.json', $.scout_account_id, $.application_name, $.job_id)", "Body": {"state": "running", "started_at.$": "$.workflow_metadata.started_at", "phase": "data_analysis", "message": "Analyzing data structures..."}, "ContentType": "application/json"}, "ResultPath": "$.status_update_result", "Next": "ParallelDataAnalysis"}, "ParallelDataAnalysis": {"Type": "Parallel", "Comment": "Run Regex, AST, and AI data analyzers in parallel", "Branches": [{"StartAt": "RegexDataExtractor", "States": {"RegexDataExtractor": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2RegexDataExtractor", "Payload": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 3, "BackoffRate": 2.0}], "End": true}}}, {"StartAt": "ASTDataAnalyzer", "States": {"ASTDataAnalyzer": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2ASTDataAnalyzer", "Payload": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 3, "BackoffRate": 2.0}], "End": true}}}, {"StartAt": "PrepareDataBatches", "States": {"PrepareDataBatches": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Split files into batches for AI data analysis", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2PrepareDataBatches", "Payload": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash"}}, "ResultPath": "$.batch_preparation", "Next": "CheckBatchCount"}, "CheckBatchCount": {"Type": "Choice", "Comment": "Check if there are batches to process", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.batch_preparation.Payload.body.total_batches", "NumericGreaterThan": 0, "Next": "DataAnalyzerMap"}], "Default": "SkipAIDataAnalysis"}, "DataAnalyzerMap": {"Type": "Map", "Comment": "Process AI data analysis batches in parallel", "MaxConcurrency": 40, "ItemsPath": "$.batch_preparation.Payload.body.batches", "Parameters": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash", "batch.$": "$$.Map.Item.Value"}, "Iterator": {"StartAt": "ProcessDataBatch", "States": {"ProcessDataBatch": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2BedrockAnalyzerBatch", "Payload.$": "$"}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 5, "MaxAttempts": 3, "BackoffRate": 2.0}], "End": true}}}, "ResultPath": "$.batch_results", "Next": "MergeDataBatches"}, "MergeDataBatches": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Merge all AI data batch results", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2MergeDataBatches", "Payload": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash", "total_batches.$": "$.batch_preparation.Payload.body.total_batches", "total_files.$": "$.batch_preparation.Payload.body.total_files"}}, "End": true}, "SkipAIDataAnalysis": {"Type": "Pass", "Comment": "No files to analyze with AI", "Result": {"statusCode": 200, "body": {"status": "skipped", "message": "No COBOL files for AI data analysis"}}, "End": true}}}], "ResultPath": "$.parallel_results", "Next": "UpdateStatusERDGeneration", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "Next": "HandleDataAnalysisError", "ResultPath": "$.error"}]}, "UpdateStatusERDGeneration": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Update status to ERD generation phase", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putObject", "Parameters": {"Bucket": "code-transformation-v2", "Key.$": "States.Format('{}/{}/data_analysis_v2/jobs/{}/status.json', $.scout_account_id, $.application_name, $.job_id)", "Body": {"state": "running", "started_at.$": "$.workflow_metadata.started_at", "phase": "erd_generation", "message": "Generating ERD and data lineage..."}, "ContentType": "application/json"}, "ResultPath": "$.status_update_result", "Next": "ERDGenerator"}, "ERDGenerator": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Generate ERD from all data analysis sources", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "DataAnalysisV2ERDGenerator", "Payload": {"job_id.$": "$.job_id", "scout_account_id.$": "$.scout_account_id", "application_name.$": "$.application_name", "source_hash.$": "$.source_hash"}}, "ResultPath": "$.erd_result", "Next": "UpdateStatusCompleted", "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "MaxAttempts": 3, "BackoffRate": 2.0}], "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "Next": "HandleERDGenerationError", "ResultPath": "$.error"}]}, "UpdateStatusCompleted": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Update job status to completed", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putObject", "Parameters": {"Bucket": "code-transformation-v2", "Key.$": "States.Format('{}/{}/data_analysis_v2/jobs/{}/status.json', $.scout_account_id, $.application_name, $.job_id)", "Body": {"state": "completed", "started_at.$": "$.workflow_metadata.started_at", "completed_at.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime", "phase": "completed", "message": "ERD generation completed successfully", "outputs": {"erd.$": "$.erd_result.Payload.body.output_path"}}, "ContentType": "application/json"}, "Next": "Success"}, "Success": {"Type": "Succeed", "Comment": "Workflow completed successfully"}, "HandleDataAnalysisError": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Handle data analysis failure", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putObject", "Parameters": {"Bucket": "code-transformation-v2", "Key.$": "States.Format('{}/{}/data_analysis_v2/jobs/{}/status.json', $.scout_account_id, $.application_name, $.job_id)", "Body": {"state": "failed", "started_at.$": "$.workflow_metadata.started_at", "failed_at.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime", "phase": "data_analysis", "error_type": "data_analysis_error", "error.$": "$.error"}, "ContentType": "application/json"}, "Next": "Failure"}, "HandleERDGenerationError": {"Type": "Task", "Comment": "Handle ERD generation failure", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:s3:putObject", "Parameters": {"Bucket": "code-transformation-v2", "Key.$": "States.Format('{}/{}/data_analysis_v2/jobs/{}/status.json', $.scout_account_id, $.application_name, $.job_id)", "Body": {"state": "failed", "started_at.$": "$.workflow_metadata.started_at", "failed_at.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime", "phase": "erd_generation", "error_type": "erd_error", "error.$": "$.error"}, "ContentType": "application/json"}, "Next": "Failure"}, "Failure": {"Type": "Fail", "Comment": "Workflow failed"}}}
